description: Replace ONE product's safety documents (EU GPSR) — the whole list: a document left out is removed. Each is a public https link to a PDF that marketplaces fetch themselves (Amazon's compliance_media), its kind (safety_information, user_manual, declaration_of_conformity, certificate) and the language it is written in. At most 10. Use only links the user gave — never invent a document. A new Amazon listing carries them; an existing offer gets them through update_amazon_listing_content with parts ["documents"]. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

documents.description: The product's full list of safety documents.

locale.description: The language it is written in (ISO 639-1).

name.description: A short name shown in the CRM.

url.description: A public https link to the PDF.

productId.description: A product id returned by search_products.

name: set_product_safety_documents
title: Set product safety documents
